background: Morgan Stanley Bank, N.A. is the main US deposit-taking bank of Morgan Stanley, holding the firm's lending to wealth management clients and corporates, funded largely by brokerage sweep deposits.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and Aa3 from Moody's, all stable. The ratios are the strongest of the US banks held here: CET1 of 18.2%, leverage of 10.4% and LCR of 129% are all in the top quarter, against medians of 12.1%, 5.8% and 117%. CET1 has fallen 2.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, so the bank is being run with a little less capital than before, though still far above its peers. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A very well-capitalised bank inside a markets-and-wealth group.
